subject: AcmePrime request - provisioning source-of-truth + entitlement change hashes
messages:
From: Elena Park <security@acmeprime.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 15:22:00 -0000
Subject: Request: provisioning source-of-truth and entitlement change hashes for SIG

Hi Tessa,

As part of our ongoing SIG + CAIQ review for the upcoming SOC 2 audit, we need to validate Redwood's provisioning and entitlement change history for our tenant (AcmePrime). Specifically we'd like the following artifacts for the date range 2027-04-01 -> 2027-04-29: 

- SCIM delta export (timestamps, user_id, external_id, operation type, delta payload)
- A small set of SAML assertion captures for both interactive SSO and service-to-service token flows (redact PII but preserve NameID and attribute mappings)
- Role ownership roster showing current role definitions, owners, and last-modified hashes/commit ids
- A short narrative (1 page) describing how least-privilege is enforced and how role pruning is performed (who signs off, cadence)

Can you confirm you can provide these within 7 business days? We may also ask for provenance (where the SCIM events are stored, retention settings) and a checksum/hash of the exported CSV for integrity.

Thanks,
Elena Park
InfoSec Manager, AcmePrime
security@acmeprime.com

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>

Hi Elena,

Thanks for the clear list — we can provide the artifacts you outlined. To confirm scope quickly:

- Environment: do you want data from your production tenant only, or should we include staging/test tenants as well?
- For SAML assertions we will redact any PII and provide samples for the two flows you mentioned.
- We will include a SHA256 checksum for the SCIM CSV and a short provenance note (storage path, retention window).

Internal owners: looping in Irene (provisioning/SCIM) and Jonas (SAML/assertion samples). Jon and Irene, please review the ask below and reply with any blockers.

Target delivery: aiming for 2027-05-06 EOD (which is within 7 business days). If we need formal attestation (signed cover letter) let us know and we can route to legal.

Deliverables (prelim): scim_delta_20270401-20270429.csv (sha256), saml_assertions_samples.txt (redacted), role_ownership_roster_v1.xlsx, least_privilege_narrative.docx (one page).

Elena — I'll send a consolidated package and a Drive link for download on 2027-05-06.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Head of Customer Security Programs
Redwood Inference
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: irene_choi@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0000
Subject: FW: AcmePrime security ask — owner assignments + deliverables

Folks — forwarding AcmePrime's request and my reply. Please see owner assignments and the expected deliverables below. We need to assemble the package and surface any redaction concerns asap.

Assignments:
- Irene: produce SCIM delta export for 2027-04-01 -> 2027-04-29. Include fields: timestamp (UTC), user_id, external_id, op_type (create/update/delete), prior_state_hash (if available), actor_id. Provide sha256 checksum for final CSV.
- Jonas: collect 4 SAML assertion captures (2 interactive, 2 service) with sensitive attributes redacted. Include assertion timestamps and the relying party entityIDs. Note whether assertions are generated by our Hosted API or by customer-managed IdP flows.
- Tessa: compile role_ownership_roster_v1.xlsx (role name, description, owner, last_modified_iso, change_hash), and draft least_privilege_narrative.docx (who signs off on role changes, pruning cadence).

Delivery plan:
- Draft package in shared Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-acmeproofs (invite already sent to acmeprime-security@acmeprime.com)
- Internal review: 2027-05-05 11:00 PT (quick sync, 30m) — please confirm availability.
- Final upload: 2027-05-06 EOD.

Notes: redact email addresses and subject lines in SAML captures where required; do not include raw tokens. If you need to pull logs from Dedicated pools vs Hosted, call it out — we should only export the tenant-scoped events for AcmePrime.

Thanks — Tessa

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <security@acmeprime.com>
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 6 May 2027 14:48:00 -0000
Subject: Delivery: AcmePrime provisioning + entitlement evidence package (SCIM, SAML, role roster)

Hi Elena —

Per our plan, we've uploaded the requested artifacts to the shared Drive folder and attached the key files to this message:

Attachments (stubs):
- scim_delta_20270401-20270429.csv (sha256: a3f5b2e7c9d4f6b8e2c4a1b9e0f4d3c7f6b2a1c0d5e8f9a0b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c)
- saml_assertions_samples.txt (4 redacted captures)
- role_ownership_roster_v1.xlsx
- least_privilege_narrative.docx

Download link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-acmeproofs

Notes / caveats:
- SCIM export contains only tenant-scoped events for AcmePrime (no global admin events). We included prior_state_hash where available; rows with missing prior_state_hash are noted in the CSV footer.
- SAML captures have been redacted to remove Personally Identifiable Information; NameID, attribute mappings, and relying party entityIDs are preserved.
- The role roster captures current role definitions and the owner assigned in our Console. The change_hash column is a digest of the role JSON at the time of last update — not a Git commit id.

If you need an attestation letter or a breakdown by cloud-region, let us know and we can add that. Happy to join a short walkthrough call next week to step through the artifacts.

Best regards,
Tessa Morgan
Head of Customer Security Programs
Redwood Inference
